resolution.note: startEgress falls back to /tmp when the parent is too deep; regression test against a live socket

title: Egress socket falls back to a short directory when the parent path is too long
body:
startEgress (evals/units/egress.ts) throws "egress socket path too long for a unix socket" when its parent (tmpdir(), the test worker TMPDIR) sits under a long lane worktree path; 20 npm test failures block every lane ship from .krn/worktrees/<branch>.
Files: evals/units/egress.ts, test/evals/egress.test.ts
Outcome: startEgress under a 120-byte parent returns a socket path of at most 107 bytes and serves; npm test in .krn/worktrees/lane-start-slim shows 0 egress-path failures.
Proof: node --test test/evals/egress.test.ts passes with the new long-parent regression test.
